scripts.clear-cache: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=require('path');const dir=p.join(process.cwd(),'node_modules','.tmp');if(fs.existsSync(dir)){fs.rmSync(dir,{recursive:true,force:true});console.log('[clear-cache] removed node_modules/.tmp')}else{console.log('[clear-cache] nothing to remove')};const vite=p.join(process.cwd(),'node_modules','.vite');if(fs.existsSync(vite)){fs.rmSync(vite,{recursive:true,force:true});console.log('[clear-cache] removed node_modules/.vite')}"
